Name: (JA) DustBeauty's Succulent Crops and Craftables
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]

This is an updated version of the mod. This mod utilized purely the assets of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5310]original mod[/url].

The only modification I added here are:
[b]- making the 'decorative succulent' (the one with pink) to produce an edible sap.
- adding buffs for both the crops (blue and pink succulent) upon harvest.
- making the other crop regrow after harvest (just like hops).[/b]

Permission can be checked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]here[/url].

If you have any in-game issues or bugs, please ensure to include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] (and image if applicable). Without info, I won't be able to help. 

[img]https://imgur.com/EwJVIBf.png[/img]

1. Download the mod and its requirements 
2. Extract and put it inside your Mods folder
3. Launch the game

[img]https://i.imgur.com/48TG8z2.png[/img]

Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]Dustbeauty[/url]! I love her mods so much and it's been the first ones I use when I first played the game with mods.
